Title 3—The President
Executive Order 11999 June 27, 1977
Relating to Certain Positions in Level V of the Executive Schedule
By virtue of the authority vested in me by Section 5317 of Title 5 of the United  
States Code, and as President of the United -States of America, Section 2 of  
Executive Order No. 11861, as amended, placing certain positions in level V  of the  
Executive Schedule, is further amended by adding thereto “ (14) Assistant to the  
Secretary and Land Utilization Adviser, Department of the Interior.” and “ (15)  
Executive Assistant and Counselor to the Secretary, Department of Labor.”.
